title: "Method paralysis"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Diagnose

Start from the inference, not the familiar technique. Which claim must the evidence support, under what assumptions?

## Do now

1. Map question → evidence → design → sample/material → measure → analysis → claim.
2. Compare two or three feasible method families.
3. List decisive assumptions, access, expertise, burden, risk and time.
4. Test the cheapest fragile assumption.
5. Seek method-specific advice with the completed comparison.
6. Record a provisional choice and review trigger.

## Before asking

Bring the inference target, options table, decisive test results, remaining uncertainty and recommendation.

## Stop or escalate

Pause when no option meets approval, safety or minimal inference requirements. Do not select a method because software is available or a paper used it.

## Evidence of unstuck

One provisional method is selected for stated reasons, with assumptions, authority, pilot and stop conditions visible.

Use the [method-options table](../templates/method-options.qmd) and [method decision record](../templates/method-decision.qmd).
